Minecraft speedrunning is by itself not
a secret. It's been around for a long
time. Maybe you watch Curryway at some
point or XQC versus Forsen or or whoever
else. But MCSR Ranked is a completely
[music] different beast. It takes
speedrunning and makes it into a 1v one
game with ELO included. The idea of it
is pretty simple. You get two people,
they go head-to-head, and the first
person to beat the Minecraft world wins.
And to make things even, you play on the
same exact [music] seed. The problem
with that is if you do it, there's a
chance that the seed you're going to
[music] get is god awful, and it will
take hours of your life. So, the devs
decided to come up with filtered seed
groups. It will put you in worlds that
guarantee the things you look for to
beat the game somewhat quickly. I
